name: Circle of Dreams
description: A legacy druid subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Balm of the Summer Court
grants.description: Gain a pool of d6s equal to your Druid level, restored on a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action, choose a creature within 120 feet and spend up to half your Druid level in dice; it regains the total rolled and gains 1 Temporary Hit Point per die.

grants.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
grants.description: At the start of a Short or Long Rest, create an invisible 30-foot-radius sphere around a touched point. Inside it, you and allies gain +5 to Stealth and Perception, and open-flame light cannot be seen outside. It ends with the rest or when you leave.

grants.name: Hidden Paths
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, teleport yourself up to 60 feet to a visible empty space, or as an action teleport a willing creature you touch up to 30 feet. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1, restored on a Long Rest.

grants.name: Walker in Dreams
grants.description: After a Short Rest, cast Dream as its messenger, Scrying, or Teleportation Circle without a slot or material components. This circle leads to your most recent Long Rest location on the same plane. Regain use after a Long Rest.
